https://mastodon.social/@SuperSelena64@h.name: Selena the Retro-Princess
https://mastodon.social/@SuperSelena64@h.text: I randomly ran into the Saturn King of Fighters 95 ROM cart at a thrift store! It's a RAM expansion with game assets to speed up loading time - the game doesn't work without it, and of course it's region-locked to Japan and didn't get North American release. But the trick to getting it to work? Assuming you can launch a JP disk (ODE or region switch) you just wait until your North American BIOS screen "licensed by Sega" goes away, then connect the cart! Otherwise it'll give you an error. It's so funny that this works! #retrogaming #sega #saturn #kingoffighters
